judged_text: When every submitted guest is filtered out (already an attendee or blacklisted), the error returned is 'emails_must_be_unique_valid', which misdescribes what went wrong. An organizer re-adding an existing attendee, or one whose guests are all blacklisted, sees 'Emails must be unique and valid' for perfectly valid, unique emails — the message points debugging in the wrong direction and the user has no way to learn the real cause (duplicate/blacklisted).

adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, after filtering out emails that are already attendees or blacklisted (`uniqueGuests`), the code throws `TRPCError({ code: "BAD_REQUEST", message: "emails_must_be_unique_valid" })` when `uniqueGuests.length === 0`. This can happen even when the submitted emails are syntactically valid and unique, but all were removed due to being existing attendees or blacklisted. The returned message therefore misdescribes the actual cause, matching the finding.
